baalghor_omen_of_the_end.text_zh:
每当你将一张牌资源时，放逐它。
从你的放逐区使用的攻击行动牌获得+3力量。
baalghor_omen_of_the_end.text_en:
Whenever you pitch a card, banish it.
Attack action cards played from your banished zone get +3{p}.

back_alley_breakline.text_zh: 若启动式异能或行动牌效果将后巷突破口从你的牌库正面朝上置入某个区域，获得1个行动点。
back_alley_breakline.text_en: If an activated ability or action card effect puts Back Alley Breakline face up into a zone from your deck, gain 1 action point.

back_for_seconds.text_zh: 目标剑攻击获得+2力量。若这是你本回合的第二次攻击，改为其获得+3力量。
back_for_seconds.text_en: Target sword attack gets +2{p}. If it's your second attack this turn, instead it gets +3{p}.

back_heel_kick.text_zh: 连击——若双旋风是本战斗链的最后一次攻击，当此牌在任意区域正面朝上且将获得力量时，改为其获得等量加1的力量。
back_heel_kick.text_en: Combo - If Twin Twisters was the last attack this combat chain, while this is face-up in any zone and would gain {p}, instead it gains that much plus 1.

back_stab.text_zh:
隐匿
此链环中防御反应牌不能被使用。
back_stab.text_en:
Stealth
Defense reaction cards can't be played this chain link.

backside_of_the_blade.text_zh: 目标武器攻击获得+1力量。若其具有再动，本回合你可以用该武器额外攻击一次。
backside_of_the_blade.text_en: Target weapon attack gets +1{p}. If it has go again, you may attack an additional time with the weapon this turn.

backspin_thrust.text_zh: 每回合一次瞬间——重置你控制的一个齿轮：此牌获得+1力量或再动。
backspin_thrust.text_en: Once per Turn Instant - {u} a cog you control: This gets +1{p} or go again.

backup_protocol_blu.text_zh:
上弦
此牌进入竞技场时带有一个蒸汽指示物。在你的回合开始时，除非你从此牌上移除一个蒸汽指示物，否则摧毁它。
瞬间——支付2点资源，摧毁此牌：将你坟场中的一张蓝色机械师攻击行动牌移回你的手牌。
backup_protocol_blu.text_en:
Crank
This enters the arena with a steam counter. At the start of your turn, destroy this unless you remove a steam counter from it.
Instant - {r}{r}, destroy this: Return a blue Mechanologist attack action card from your graveyard to your hand.

backup_protocol_red.text_zh:
上弦
此牌进入竞技场时带有一个蒸汽指示物。在你的回合开始时，除非你从此牌上移除一个蒸汽指示物，否则摧毁它。
瞬间——支付2点资源，摧毁此牌：将你坟场中的一张红色机械师攻击行动牌移回你的手牌。
backup_protocol_red.text_en:
Crank
This enters the arena with a steam counter. At the start of your turn, destroy this unless you remove a steam counter from it.
Instant - {r}{r}, destroy this: Return a red Mechanologist attack action card from your graveyard to your hand.

backup_protocol_yel.text_zh:
上弦
此牌进入竞技场时带有一个蒸汽指示物。在你的回合开始时，除非你从此牌上移除一个蒸汽指示物，否则摧毁它。
瞬间——支付2点资源，摧毁此牌：将你坟场中的一张黄色机械师攻击行动牌移回你的手牌。
backup_protocol_yel.text_en:
Crank
This enters the arena with a steam counter. At the start of your turn, destroy this unless you remove a steam counter from it.
Instant - {r}{r}, destroy this: Return a yellow Mechanologist attack action card from your graveyard to your hand.

bad_beats.text_zh:
掷一枚六面骰。若掷出4、5或6，本回合你使用的下一张蛮将攻击行动牌获得+5力量。
再动
bad_beats.text_en:
Roll a 6 sided die. If the number rolled is a 4, 5, or 6, the next Brute attack action card you play this turn gains +5{p}.
Go again

bad_breath.text_zh:
威吓目标英雄。
本回合你控制的攻击下一次命中时，创造3个力量衍生物。
再动
bad_breath.text_en:
Intimidate target hero.
The next time an attack you control hits this turn, create 3 Might tokens.
Go again

bait.text_zh:
你不能使用或启动你拥有的牌。
行动——当链环结算时摧毁此牌：攻击
每回合一次攻击反应——费用0：此牌获得+1力量和再动。
bait.text_en:
You can't play or activate cards you own.
Action - Destroy this when the chain link resolves: Attack
Once per Turn Attack Reaction - 0: This gets +1{p} and go again.

balance_of_justice.text_zh:
瞬间——摧毁此牌：抽一张牌。仅当对手本回合抽过两张或更多牌时才能启动。
守御
balance_of_justice.text_en:
Instant - Destroy this: Draw a card. Activate this only if an opponent has drawn 2 or more cards this turn.
Guardwell

ball_breaker.text_zh:
每回合一次行动——支付2点资源：攻击
若本回合你弃置过一张力量为6或更高的牌，此牌获得+1力量。
ball_breaker.text_en:
Once per Turn Action - {r}{r}: Attack
If you've discarded a card with 6 or more {p} this turn, this gets +1{p}.

ball_lightning.text_zh:
本战斗链中每当闪电或元素行动牌将造成伤害时，改为它造成等量加1的伤害。
再动
ball_lightning.text_en:
Whenever a Lightning or Elemental action card would deal damage this combat chain, instead it deals that much damage plus 1.
Go again

bam_bam.text_zh:
当此牌命中英雄时，摧毁其控制的一个物品。
瞬间——弃掉此牌：本回合你的棒攻击获得“当此牌命中英雄时，摧毁其控制的一个物品。”
bam_bam.text_en:
When this hits a hero, destroy an item they control.
Instant - Discard this: Your club attacks this turn get "When this hits a hero, destroy an item they control."

bandana_of_the_blue_beyond.text_zh: 行动——弃一张牌，摧毁此牌：将你坟场中的一张蓝色牌置于牌库底。再动
bandana_of_the_blue_beyond.text_en: Action - Discard a card, destroy this: Put a blue card from your graveyard on the bottom of your deck. Go again

bank_breaker.text_zh:
每回合两次行动——支付1点资源：攻击。仅当本回合你上弦过时才能启动此异能。
当此牌攻击时，你可以放逐其下的一张牌。若如此做，该攻击获得压制和再动。
bank_breaker.text_en:
Twice per Turn Action - {r}: Attack. Activate this only if you've cranked this turn.
When this attacks, you may banish a card from under it. If you do, the attack gets overpower and go again.

banksy.text_zh:
马克斯专精
每回合一次行动——支付1点资源：攻击。仅当本回合你上弦过时才能启动此异能。
当此牌命中英雄时，在你控制的一个具有上弦的物品上放置一个蒸汽指示物。
banksy.text_en:
Maxx Specialization
Once per Turn Action - {r}: Attack. Activate this ability only if you've cranked this turn.
When this hits a hero, put a steam counter on an item you control with crank.

banneret_of_courage.type_zh: 光 战士 行动·攻击
banneret_of_courage.text_zh: 日耀——当此牌被充能至你的英雄的灵魂时，创造一个勇气衍生物。
banneret_of_courage.text_en: Solflare - When this is charged to your hero's soul, create a Courage token.

banneret_of_gallantry.type_zh: 光 战士 行动·攻击
banneret_of_gallantry.text_zh: 日耀——当此牌被充能至你的英雄的灵魂时，创造一个加速衍生物。
banneret_of_gallantry.text_en: Solflare - When this is charged to your hero's soul, create a Quicken token.

banneret_of_protection.type_zh: 光 战士 行动·攻击
banneret_of_protection.text_zh: 日耀——当此牌被充能至你的英雄的灵魂时，创造一个法殁神盾衍生物。
banneret_of_protection.text_en: Solflare - When this is charged to your hero's soul, create a Spellbane Aegis token.

banneret_of_resilience.type_zh: 光 战士 行动·攻击
banneret_of_resilience.text_zh: 日耀——当此牌被充能至你的英雄的灵魂时，本回合你用于防御的下一张行动牌获得+1防御。
banneret_of_resilience.text_en: Solflare - When this is charged to your hero's soul, the next action card you defend with this turn gets +1{d}.

banneret_of_salvation.type_zh: 光 战士 行动·攻击
banneret_of_salvation.text_zh: 日耀——当此牌被充能至你的英雄的灵魂时，本回合你下一次命中时，获得1点生命。
banneret_of_salvation.text_en: Solflare - When this is charged to your hero's soul, the next time you hit this turn, gain 1{h}.

banneret_of_vigor.type_zh: 光 战士 行动·攻击
banneret_of_vigor.text_zh: 日耀——当此牌被充能至你的英雄的灵魂时，本回合你下一次命中时，获得1点资源。
banneret_of_vigor.text_en: Solflare - When this is charged to your hero's soul, the next time you hit this turn, gain {r}.

barbed_barrage.type_zh: 游侠 行动·箭矢 攻击
barbed_barrage.text_zh: 作为使用此牌的额外费用，你可以支付3点资源。若如此做，此牌额外攻击一个目标。
barbed_barrage.text_en: As an additional cost to play this, you may pay {r}{r}{r}. If you do, this attacks an additional target.

barbed_castaway.text_zh:
每回合一次瞬间——支付1点资源：你可以将你手牌中的一张箭矢牌正面朝上放入你的军械库。
每回合一次瞬间——支付1点资源：你可以将你军械库中的一张牌面朝下的箭矢翻为正面朝上。若如此做，在其上放置一个瞄准指示物。
barbed_castaway.text_en:
Once per Turn Instant - {r}: You may put an arrow card from your hand face up into your arsenal.
Once per Turn Instant - {r}: You may turn a face down arrow in your arsenal face up. If you do, put an aim counter on it.

barbed_undertow.type_zh: 游侠 行动·箭矢 攻击
barbed_undertow.text_zh: 若倒刺暗流带有一个瞄准指示物，它获得“当此牌命中英雄时，选择红色、黄色或蓝色。直到你的下一个回合开始，该英雄不能资源所选颜色的牌。”
barbed_undertow.text_en: If Barbed Undertow has an aim counter, it gains "When this hits a hero, choose red, yellow, or blue. Until the start of your next turn, they can't pitch cards of the chosen color."

bare_destruction.text_zh:
捶胸
当此牌攻击时，若本回合你捶胸过且你没有控制胸部装备，此牌获得再动，且本回合你使用的下一张蛮将攻击行动牌获得+2力量。
bare_destruction.text_en:
Beat Chest
When this attacks, if you've beaten chest this turn and you don't control a chest equipment, this gets go again and the next Brute attack action card you play this turn gets +2{p}.

bare_fangs.text_zh: 当此牌攻击时，抽一张牌，然后随机弃一张牌。若以此方式弃置的是力量为6或更高的牌，獠牙毕露获得+2力量。
bare_fangs.text_en: When this attacks, draw a card then discard a random card. If a card with 6 or more {p} is discarded this way, Bare Fangs gains +2{p}.

bare_swing.text_zh:
捶胸
当此牌攻击时，若本回合你捶胸过且你没有控制胸部装备，此牌获得+2力量。
bare_swing.text_en:
Beat Chest
When this attacks, if you've beaten chest this turn and you don't control a chest equipment, this gets +2{p}.

bark_obscenities.text_zh:
本回合你的下一次以守护者英雄为目标的攻击获得+4力量。
再动
bark_obscenities.text_en:
Your next attack that targets a Guardian hero this turn gets +4{p}.
Go again

barkbone_strapping.text_zh:
瞬间——摧毁树皮骨绑带：掷一枚六面骰。获得等于掷出数字一半（向下取整）的资源。
战痕
barkbone_strapping.text_en:
Instant - Destroy Barkbone Strapping: Roll a 6 die. Gain {r} equal to half the number rolled, rounded down.
Battleworn

barkskin_of_the_millennium_tree.text_zh:
当此牌防御时，若你的放逐区有四张或更多大地牌，创造一个大地化身衍生物。
淬炼
barkskin_of_the_millennium_tree.text_en:
When this defends, if there are 4 or more Earth cards in your banished zone, create an Embodiment of Earth token.
Temper

barnacle.text_zh:
行动——横置此牌：攻击
水葬

barraging_beatdown.text_zh:
你本回合的下一次蛮将攻击获得“当此攻击被少于2张非装备牌防御时，它获得+4力量。”
威吓
再动
barraging_beatdown.text_en:
Your next Brute attack this turn gains "While this attack is defended by less than 2 non-equipment cards, it has +4{p}."
Intimidate
Go again

barraging_big_horn.text_zh:
作为使用连续大角的额外费用，随机弃一张牌。
当连续大角被少于2张非装备牌防御时，它获得再动。
barraging_big_horn.text_en:
As an additional cost to play Barraging Big Horn, discard a random card.
While Barraging Big Horn is defended by less than 2 non-equipment cards, it has go again.

barraging_brawnhide.text_zh: 当连射蛮皮被少于2张非装备牌防御时，它获得+1力量。
barraging_brawnhide.text_en: While Barraging Brawnhide is defended by less than 2 non-equipment cards, it has +1{p}.

basalt_boots.text_zh:
若你控制一个地震涌动衍生物，此牌获得+1防御。
淬炼
basalt_boots.text_en:
If you control a Seismic Surge token, this gets +1{d}.
Temper

base_of_the_mountain.text_zh:
当此牌防御时，放逐你手牌中的任意数量行动牌，然后将它们作为防御牌加入链环。
此牌的防御等于当前链环上防御的行动牌数量。
刃碎
base_of_the_mountain.text_en:
When this defends, banish any number of action cards from your hand, then add them to the chain link as defending cards.
This card's {d} is equal to the number of action cards defending on the active chain link.
Blade Break

bash_brute.text_zh:
若此牌被蛮将牌防御，此牌获得+1力量。
当此牌命中蛮将英雄时，摧毁其控制的一个光环衍生物。
bash_brute.text_en:
If this is defended by a Brute card, this gets +1{p}.
When this hits a Brute hero, destroy an aura token they control.

bash_guardian.text_zh:
若此牌被守护者牌防御，此牌获得+1力量。
当此牌命中守护者英雄时，摧毁其控制的一个光环衍生物。
bash_guardian.text_en:
If this is defended by a Guardian card, this gets +1{p}.
When this hits a Guardian hero, destroy an aura token they control.

bask_in_your_own_greatness.text_zh: 当此牌攻击时，你可以支付至多3点资源。创造等量的力量衍生物。
bask_in_your_own_greatness.text_en: When this attacks, you may pay up to {r}{r}{r}. Create that many Might tokens.

bastion_of_unity.text_zh:
团结——当此牌与一张来自手牌的牌一起防御时，此牌直到回合结束获得+1防御。
淬炼
bastion_of_unity.text_en:
Unity - When this defends together with a card from hand, this gets +1{d} until end of turn.
Temper

battalion_barque.text_zh: 涨潮——若你资源区中有2张或更多蓝色牌，此牌获得+2力量。
battalion_barque.text_en: High Tide - If there are 2 or more blue cards in your pitch zone, this gets +2{p}.

batter_to_a_pulp.text_zh:
若此牌将造成4点或更多伤害，该伤害不能被防止。
粉碎——当此牌对英雄造成4点或更多伤害时，摧毁其控制的没有防御值的一件装备。
batter_to_a_pulp.text_en:
If this would deal 4 or more damage, that damage can't be prevented.
Crush - When this deals 4 or more damage to a hero, destroy an equipment they control with no defense value.

battered_beaten_and_broken.text_zh:
当此牌攻击英雄时，威吓该英雄。
若你控制3个或更多光环，此牌获得+3力量，以及“当此牌命中英雄时，摧毁该英雄拥有的一张被威吓的牌。”
battered_beaten_and_broken.text_en:
When this attacks a hero, intimidate them.
If you control 3 or more auras, this gets +3{p} and "When this hits a hero, destroy an intimidated card they own."

battered_not_broken.text_zh: 本回合接下来你将受到伤害时，防止其中2点伤害。若如此做，创造一个力量衍生物。
battered_not_broken.text_en: The next time you would be dealt damage this turn, prevent 2 of that damage. If you do, create a Might token.

battering_bolt.type_zh: 游侠 行动·箭矢 攻击
battering_bolt.text_zh: 若猛击箭命中英雄，该英雄展示其手牌并弃掉所有行动牌以外的牌。然后该英雄每以此方式弃一张牌失去1点生命。
battering_bolt.text_en: If Battering Bolt hits a hero, they reveal their hand and discard all cards other than action cards. Then they lose 1{h} for each card discarded this way.

battlefield_beacon.type_zh: 光 战士 行动·攻击
battlefield_beacon.text_zh:
当此牌攻击时，为本战斗链中你从灵魂放逐的每张牌选择其一。你可以重复选择同一模式至多3次；
- 创造一个勇气衍生物。
- 创造一个坚韧衍生物。
- 创造一个活力衍生物。
battlefield_beacon.text_en:
When this attacks, choose 1 for each card you've banished from your soul this combat chain. You may choose the same mode up to 3 times;
- Create a Courage token.
- Create a Toughness token.
- Create a Vigor token.

battlefield_blitz.type_zh: 光 战士 行动·攻击
battlefield_blitz.text_zh: 若本回合你充能过，战场突袭获得再动。
battlefield_blitz.text_en: If you've charged this turn, Battlefield Blitz gains go again.

battlefield_breaker.type_zh: 暗影 蛮将 行动·攻击
battlefield_breaker.text_zh:
若本回合你放逐过一张力量为6或更高的牌，此牌获得+1力量。
血债
battlefield_breaker.text_en:
If you've banished a card with 6 or more {p} this turn, this gets +1{p}.
Blood Debt

battlefront_bastion.text_zh: 当此牌单独防御时，防止本回合接下来将对你造成的1点伤害。
battlefront_bastion.text_en: When this defends alone, prevent the next 1 damage that would be dealt to you this turn.

be_like_water.text_zh:
当此牌命中时，你可以支付1点资源。若如此做，选择刺拳、激涌打击或双旋风。此牌获得所选名称。
再动
be_like_water.text_en:
When this hits, you may pay {r}. If you do, choose Head Jab, Surging Strike, or Twin Twisters. This gains the chosen name.
Go again

beacon_of_victory.type_zh: 光 战士 攻击反应
beacon_of_victory.text_zh:
作为使用胜利信标的额外费用，从你的英雄的灵魂中放逐X张牌。X不能为0。
目标攻击获得+X力量。
若本回合你充能过，从你的牌库中搜寻一张费用为X或更低的行动牌，展示它，将其置入你的手牌，然后洗牌。
beacon_of_victory.text_en:
As an additional cost to play Beacon of Victory, banish X cards from your hero's soul. X can't be 0.
Target attack gains +X{p}.
If you've charged this turn, search your deck for an action card with cost X or less, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle your deck.

beaming_blade.type_zh: 光 战士 武器·剑 （双手）
beaming_blade.text_zh:
每回合一次行动——支付2点资源：攻击
若本回合有黄色牌被置入你的英雄的灵魂，此牌获得+5力量。
beaming_blade.text_en:
Once per Turn Action - {r}{r}: Attack
If a yellow card has been put into your hero's soul this turn, this gets +5{p}.

beaming_bravado.type_zh: 光 战士 行动·攻击
beaming_bravado.text_zh:
作为使用此牌的额外费用，你可以为你的英雄的灵魂充能。
若以此方式充能的是黄色牌，此牌获得+1力量。
beaming_bravado.text_en:
As an additional cost to play this, you may charge your hero's soul.
If a yellow card is charged this way, this gets +1{p}

bear_hug.text_zh: 仅当本回合你资源过一张力量为6或更高的牌时才能使用此牌。
bear_hug.text_en: Play this only if you've pitched a card with 6 or more {p} this turn.

beast_mode.text_zh: 若本回合你威吓过，此牌获得+2力量。
beast_mode.text_en: If you've intimidated this turn, this gets +2{p}.

攻击反应——摧毁此牌：目标海盗盟友攻击获得再动。当战斗链关闭时，摧毁该盟友。
刃碎
breakwater_undertow.text_en:
Attack Reaction - Destroy this: Target Pirate ally attack gets go again. When the combat chain closes, destroy the ally.
Blade Break

breed_anger.text_zh: 连击——当此牌攻击时，若卧虎是本战斗链的最后一次攻击，此牌获得再动，并在你的放逐区中创造一张卧虎。本回合你可以使用它。
breed_anger.text_en: Combo - When this attacks, if Crouching Tiger was the last attack this combat chain, this gets go again and create a Crouching Tiger in your banished zone. You may play it this turn.

breeze_rider_boots.text_zh:
当你控制的忍者攻击行动牌命中时，你可以摧毁乘风之靴。若如此做，本回合具有连击的攻击行动牌获得再动。
战痕
breeze_rider_boots.text_en:
When a Ninja attack action card you control hits, you may destroy Breeze Rider Boots. If you do, attack action cards with combo gain go again this turn.
Battleworn

brevant_civic_protector.text_en:
You may have any number of Chivalry in your deck.
Whenever you protect another hero, create a Might token.

briar.text_zh:
大地与闪电精华
你控制的攻击行动牌第一次对对手英雄造成伤害时，创造一个大地化身衍生物。
每回合当你使用第二张"非攻击"行动牌时，创造一个闪电化身衍生物。
briar.text_en:
Essence of Earth and Lightning
The first time an attack action card you control deals damage to an opposing hero, create an Embodiment of Earth token.
Whenever you play your second 'non-attack' action card each turn, create an Embodiment of Lightning token.

briar_warden_of_thorns.type_zh: 元素 符文剑士 英雄
briar_warden_of_thorns.text_zh:
大地与闪电精华
你控制的攻击行动牌第一次对对手英雄造成伤害时，创造一个大地化身衍生物。
每回合当你使用第二张“非攻击”行动牌时，创造一个闪电化身衍生物。
briar_warden_of_thorns.text_en:
Essence of Earth and Lightning
The first time an attack action card you control deals damage to an opposing hero, create an Embodiment of Earth token.
Whenever you play your second 'non-attack' action card each turn, create an Embodiment of Lightning token.

brimming_blade.text_zh:
磨砺你控制的目标剑两次。
再动
brimming_blade.text_en:
Sharpen target sword you control twice.
Go again

brothers_in_arms.text_zh: 当此牌防御时，你可以支付1点资源。若如此做，它获得+2防御。
brothers_in_arms.text_en: When this defends, you may pay {r}. If you do, it gets +2{d}.

brothers_of_flame.type_zh: 龙裔 战士 攻击反应
brothers_of_flame.text_zh:
仅当你控制两个或更多龙裔链环时才能使用此牌。
目标匕首攻击获得+4力量。
brothers_of_flame.text_en:
Play this only if you control 2 or more Draconic chain links.
Target dagger attack gets +4{p}.

browbeat.text_zh: 你手牌中每有一张牌，此牌获得+1力量。
browbeat.text_en: This gets +1{p} for each card in your hand.

bruised_leather.text_zh: 瞬间——摧毁此牌：防止本回合接下来将对你造成的1点伤害。仅当本回合你受到过伤害时才能启动此异能。
bruised_leather.text_en: Instant - Destroy this: Prevent the next 1 damage that would be dealt to you this turn. Activate this only if you've been dealt damage this turn.

brush_of_heavenly_rites.text_zh: 每回合一次行动——支付2点资源：从你的物品栏装备一件名称中含有宣言的副手。再动
brush_of_heavenly_rites.text_en: Once per Turn Action - {r}{r}: Equip an off-hand with Proclamation in its name from your inventory. Go again

brush_off.text_zh: 本回合接下来你将受到的3点或更少的伤害，防止它。
brush_off.text_en: The next time you would be dealt 3 or less damage this turn, prevent it.

brutus_summa_rudis.text_zh:
你的牌库中可以包含任意职业或才能的具有交锋的牌。
若一次交锋中所有英雄都将未能获胜，改为你选择哪位英雄赢得该交锋。
brutus_summa_rudis.text_en:
You may have cards with clash of any class or talent in your deck.
If all heroes in a clash would fail to win, instead choose which hero wins the clash.

bubba_lubba_run_aground.text_zh:
此牌进入竞技场时带有一个+1力量指示物。
行动——支付1点资源，横置此牌：攻击
行动——从你控制的一个盟友上移除一个+1力量指示物：摧毁一个光环衍生物。再动
水葬
bubba_lubba_run_aground.text_en:
This enters the arena with a +1{p} counter.
Action - {r}, {t}: Attack
Action - Remove a +1{p} counter from an ally you control: Destroy an aura token. Go again
Watery Grave

bubble_to_the_surface.text_zh:
每当你控制一个龙裔链环，此牌的使用费用减少1点资源。
从你的牌库顶展示牌，直到你展示一张红色牌。放逐它。本回合你可以使用它。然后洗牌。
bubble_to_the_surface.text_en:
This costs {r} less to play for each Draconic chain link you control.
Reveal cards from the top of your deck until you've revealed a red card. Banish it. You may play it this turn. Shuffle.

buccaneers_bounty.text_zh:
行动——摧毁此牌：获得1点资源。再动
刃碎
buccaneers_bounty.text_en:
Action - Destroy this: Gain {r}. Go again
Blade Break

buckle.text_zh:
你本回合的下一次守护者攻击获得+1力量、支配，以及“当此牌命中英雄时，摧毁其控制的带有-1防御指示物的一件装备。”
再动
buckle.text_en:
Your next Guardian attack this turn gains +1{p}, dominate, and "When this hits a hero, destroy an equipment they control with a -1{d} counter on it."
Go again

buckling_blow.text_zh: 粉碎——当此牌对英雄造成4点或更多伤害时，在其控制的一件装备上放置一个-1防御指示物。
buckling_blow.text_en: Crush - When this deals 4 or more damage to a hero, put a -1{d} counter on an equipment they control.

buckwild.text_zh: 若你资源区中有一张力量为6或更高的牌，此牌获得再动。
buckwild.text_en: If there is a card with 6 or more {p} in your pitch zone, this gets go again.

bull_bar.text_zh:
推进
若你控制一张超频驱动器，此牌获得压制。
bull_bar.text_en:
Boost
If you control a Hyper Driver, this gets overpower.

bulls_eye_bracers.text_zh:
行动——摧毁牛眼护腕：若你军械库中没有牌，你可以将你手牌中的一张箭矢正面朝上放入你的军械库。它直到回合结束获得+1力量。再动
秘法屏障1
bulls_eye_bracers.text_en:
Action - Destroy Bull's Eye Bracers: If you have no cards in your arsenal, you may put an arrow card from your hand face up into your arsenal. It gains +1{p} until end of turn. Go again
Arcane Barrier 1

bully_tactics.text_zh: 当此牌攻击英雄时，你可以支付至多3点资源。威吓该英雄等量的次数。
bully_tactics.text_en: When this attacks a hero, you may pay up to {r}{r}{r}. Intimidate them that many times.

bunker_beard.text_zh: 防御反应——摧毁此牌：你可以将你军械库中的一张行动牌作为防御牌加入当前链环。
bunker_beard.text_en: Defense Reaction - Destroy this: You may add an action card from your arsenal to the active chain link as a defending card.

burdens_of_the_past.text_zh:
直到回合结束，目标英雄不能使用与其坟场中一张牌同名的防御反应牌。
若其坟场中有10张或更多防御反应牌，抽一张牌。
再动
burdens_of_the_past.text_en:
Until end of turn, target hero can't play defense reaction cards with the same name as a card in their graveyard.
If there are 10 or more defense reaction cards in their graveyard, draw a card.
Go again

burgeoning.text_zh: 若此牌是从军械库使用的，它获得+1力量。
burgeoning.text_en: If this was played from arsenal, it gains +1{p}.

burly_bones.type_zh: 海盗 Necromancer 行动·攻击
burly_bones.text_zh: 当此牌攻击时，你可以弃一张牌或摧毁你牌库顶的一张牌。若该牌具有水葬，此牌获得压制。
burly_bones.text_en: When this attacks, you may discard a card or destroy the top card of your deck. If that card has watery grave, this gets overpower.

burn_away.text_zh: 作为使用燃尽的额外费用，你可以放逐你坟场中的一张凤凰烈焰。当你如此做时，燃尽获得+2力量和再动。
burn_away.text_en: As an additional cost to play Burn Away, you may banish a Phoenix Flame from your graveyard. When you do, Burn Away gains +2{p} and go again.

burn_bare.text_zh:
对任意目标造成6点秘法伤害。
瞬间——弃掉此牌：摧毁目标正在攻击你的具有虚击的牌。
burn_bare.text_en:
Deal 6 arcane damage to any target.
Instant - Discard this: Destroy target card with phantasm that is attacking you.

burn_rubber.text_zh: 若本回合你推进过两次或更多，此牌获得+2力量，且不能被装备防御。
burn_rubber.text_en: If you've boosted 2 or more times this turn, this gets +2{p} and can't be defended by equipment.

burn_them_all.type_zh: 龙裔 幻术师 行动·光环
burn_them_all.text_zh:
再动
每回合一次，当你控制的龙攻击时，它对每位对手英雄造成1点秘法伤害。
在你的结束阶段开始时，在焚尽一切上放置一个焚毁指示物，然后除非你为其上的每个焚毁指示物将一张红色牌从你的坟场放逐，否则摧毁它。
burn_them_all.text_en:
Go again
Once per turn, when a dragon you control attacks, it deals 1 arcane damage to each opposing hero.
At the beginning of your end phase, put a raze counter on Burn Them All then destroy it unless you banish red card from your graveyard for each raze counter on it.

burn_up_shock.type_zh: 符文剑士 行动·闪电 瞬间
burn_up_shock.text_zh:
凝合
本回合你控制的攻击下一次命中英雄时，对其造成4点秘法伤害。
再动
//
对任意目标造成1点秘法伤害。
burn_up_shock.text_en:
Meld
The next time an attack you control hits a hero this turn, deal 4 arcane damage to them.
Go again
//
Deal 1 arcane damage to any target.

burning_blade_dance.type_zh: 龙裔 忍者 行动·攻击
burning_blade_dance.text_zh: 若你控制2个或更多龙裔链环，此牌获得再动，以及“当此牌命中英雄时，你可以让你控制的目标匕首对其造成1点伤害。若以此方式造成伤害，该匕首视为命中。摧毁该匕首。”
burning_blade_dance.text_en: If you control 2 or more Draconic chain links, this gets go again and "When this hits a hero, you may have target dagger you control deal 1 damage to them. If damage is dealt this way, the dagger has hit. Destroy the dagger."

burnished_bunkerplate.text_zh: 防御反应——摧毁此牌：你可以将你军械库中的一张行动牌作为防御牌加入当前链环。
burnished_bunkerplate.text_en: Defense Reaction - Destroy this: You may add an action card from your arsenal to the active chain link as a defending card.

buzz_bolt.type_zh: 元素 游侠 行动·箭矢 攻击
buzz_bolt.text_zh:
闪电融合
若嗡嗡箭已融合，本回合每当攻击命中英雄时，对其造成1点伤害。
buzz_bolt.text_en:
Lightning Fusion
If Buzz Bolt was fused, whenever an attack hits a hero this turn, it deals 1 damage to them.

buzzard_helm.text_zh:
当此牌防御时，抽一张牌，然后随机弃一张牌。若以此方式弃置的是力量为6或更高的牌，本回合此牌获得+1防御。
淬炼
buzzard_helm.text_en:
When this defends, draw a card then discard a random card. If a card with 6 or more {p} is discarded this way, this gets +1{d} this turn.
Temper

buzzsaw_trap.type_zh: 游侠 防御反应·陷阱
buzzsaw_trap.text_zh:
传奇瑞普泰德专精
当此牌防御力量大于其基础的攻击时，本回合该攻击不能获得力量。
buzzsaw_trap.text_en:
Legendary Riptide Specialization
When this defends an attack with {p} greater than its base, the attack can't gain {p} this turn.

by_the_book.text_zh:
若你的生命低于其他每位英雄，你可以将此牌当作瞬间使用。
英雄不能在行动阶段期间抽牌。
在你的行动阶段开始时，摧毁此牌。
by_the_book.text_en:
If you have less {h} than each other hero, you may play this as though it were an instant.
Heroes can't draw cards during action phases.
At the beginning of your action phase, destroy this.
